title: Chapter 365 - 365 Long Line; Welcome!

Chapter 365 - 365 Long Line; Welcome!

Chapter 365 - 365 Long Line; Welcome!

365 Long Line; Welcome!

After a hearty meal, Lin Fan did not stay in the Royal Hotel for long.

He drove the Ferrari 812 alone toward the exhibition center.

He did not know where it was because today was the last day of the perfume exhibition or if there was another reason.

There seemed to be more people at the exhibition center today than two days ago. The number of people at the entrance was at least twice as many as two days ago.

However, when Lin Fan walked into the exhibition center, he realized that it was empty. Other than a few staff members, there were no customers at all.

What was going on?

Lin Fan was a little confused as he walked forward.

The next moment, he was stunned.

Not far away, there was a dense crowd of people who were all standing in a long line.

How many people were there?

500?

1,000?

Or tens of thousands?

Everyone in the exhibition center was probably queuing up here, right?

Lin Fan followed the mass of people and strode forward, looking into the distance.

Finally, his gaze landed at the end of the line… It was Flower Stem’s booth.

These people were all queuing up for Flower Stem’s booth. Were they all here to buy the perfume?

In reality, it was just as Lin Fan had expected.

They were indeed here to buy perfumes from Flower Stem!

“Give me 1,000 bottles of each perfume!” a Caucasian man said.

“I’m sorry, but we’ve limited it to five bottles per person,” the oval-faced woman said.

“What? Five bottles? Are you trying to get rid of customers? Hurry up and get me 1,000 bottles!” The Caucasian man shouted and slammed the table.

The oval-faced woman frowned and said, “If you continue to cause trouble, we’ll blacklist you and won’t sell any products to you.”

“Then… Then give me five bottles.”

After paying, he did not leave immediately.

Instead, he turned around and went to the back of the line to queue again.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s face revealed a strange look.

At this moment, the oval-faced woman happened to see Lin Fan and said excitedly, “Mr. Lin, you’re here?”

Chu Yunyue and the others, who had been busy, stopped what they were doing and looked at Lin Fan.

Lin Fan smiled and nodded, “Yeah, I’ll help too.”

” No need,” Chu Yunyue said. “They can line up and register slowly. You can just sit and rest.”

Lin Fan smiled and said, “As a major shareholder, won’t I be too useless if I do that? Let me do something. It’s boring to just do nothing.”

Chu Yunyue thought for a moment and said, “Then you can make an electronic version of these names and addresses, classify them, and summarize them.”

“Alright,” Lin Fan replied.

Lin Fan placed his hands on the keyboard. Like a phantom, he quickly entered the names, addresses, and numbers into the laptop. Then, he categorized and summarized the areas, numbers, types, and so on.

This scene made Chu Yunyue’s eyes ripple.

Lin Fan first displayed his perfume knowledge that was far superior to ordinary people. Then, he displayed his singing voice which was like the sound of nature.

Then, with incredible medical skills, he used perfume to wake up Riley.

Today, he displayed his superb computer skill.

Lin Fan… What else could he not do?

In Chu Yunyue’s eyes, Lin Fan was shining like the sun.

The setting sun dyed the clouds in the distance red, as if celebrating the successful conclusion of this perfume exhibition.

There was still a long line at Flower Stem’s booth. After the exhibition center notified them that the event was over and security guards came to chase them away, everyone reluctantly left.

Today, all the employees of Flower Stem were extremely busy.

However, they did not show any signs of suffering.

On the contrary, their faces were full of happiness and fulfillment.

At this moment, Lin Fan said, “Everyone has worked hard these few days. Tonight, let’s go to the palace to relax.”

In the afternoon, Lin Fan received an invitation from the royal family. They wanted him to come to the palace to attend a banquet to thank him for saving Princess Riley.

At that time, Lin Fan asked if he could bring other people along.

Regarding this… the royal family directly gave an affirmative answer.

Flower Stem’s employees immediately let out excited cries.

Under the escort of the Rolls-Royce fleet, a tall and ancient-looking palace gradually appeared in Lin Fan’s and the others’ sights.

After entering, they saw clear streams, green plants of various shapes, and jagged hills everywhere. It could be said that there was a perfect scene with every step, making people linger and praise what they were seeing.

In the distance, a man in a black suit said in fluent Hua Nation language, “Mr. Lin, nice to meet you.”

Yesterday, this man had gone to the exhibition center with Queen Ibai and the others. He had been to Flower Stem’s booth as well.

Even though Lin Fan did not communicate with him at all, he had a photographic memory and easily remembered him.

When Lin Fan and the others approached, the man in the black suit continued, “I forgot to introduce myself. My name is Maron Melvin.”

It was also when they got closer that everyone smelled a familiar perfume on him. It was the scent of Flower Stem’s perfume.

“Nice to meet you, Mr. Melvin,” Lin Fan said.

“Mr. Lin, your perfume is amazing!” Maron Melvin exclaimed. “It has a wonderful smell. In addition, it makes me feel energetic. This should be considered holy water in Hua Nation, right?”

Holy water?

This was the psychological effect that Maron Melvin had after seeing Lin Fan use Flower Stem’s perfume to save Princess Riley.

Even the princess, who was suffering from a chronic illness, could be treated. Of course, it would be of great benefit to his body.

In fact, this was also one of the reasons why many people fought to buy the perfume today.

Due to the media, many people in Hua Nation felt that the locals were stupid while foreigners were smart.

In reality?

The vast majority of foreigners could not compare to the people of Hua Nation.

Lin Fan did not expose Maron Melvin’s words and said casually, “As long as you like it.”

“Of course, I like it. I won’t use any perfume that isn’t from Flower Stem in the future!” Maron Melvin immediately exclaimed.

The two of them chatted as they walked.

Not long after, they arrived at the magnificent palace.

At this moment, men and women who looked very luxurious in formal attire were standing in the palace. Some were in groups of three or two, whispering to each other, while others were chuckling with their lips pursed… The atmosphere was extremely relaxed.

Someone seemed to have noticed Lin Fan who had just walked in and could not help but say, “Welcome, Mr. Lin.”

Immediately, the people who were conversing with each other turned around in unison, and their gazes landed on today’s main character… Lin Fan.
